explanation: The credit agreement section 7.11(b) disallows add-backs except if expressly provided or amended. No amendment or executed waiver permitting the owner's compensation normalization add-back is on file, only an unexecuted waiver request. Our calculation with the boarded terms (no add-backs) matches our computed DSCR of 1.08, below the required 1.25 threshold. The borrower's higher DSCR of 1.31 includes an unsupported add-back of 530,000. Therefore, our figure reflects the true covenant terms and indicates a breach.
confidence_basis: The owner's compensation normalization add-back applied by the borrower is not permitted by the credit agreement and has not been authorised by an executed waiver or amendment; our calculation based on boarded terms shows a failing DSCR of 1.08, below the 1.25 minimum.
